shortDescription: Authentication using API token authentication for CyberArk Identity Security Platform Shared Services.

options.name: api_base_url
options.description: A string containing the base URL of the server hosting CyberArk's Privileged Cloud ISP SDK.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The login name of the service account for authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The password of the service account.

options.name: grant_type
options.description: The type of grant for the authentication.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies if an authentication logon and a cyberark_session should be added.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Allows you set a timeout for when your authenticating to Cyberark

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificate chain will not be validated.  This should only set to C(true) if you have a root CA certificate installed on each node.
